title: Cape Kidnappers Tour Review
meta_desc: Honest review of Cape Kidnappers Gannet Colony Tour, a 3-4 hour wildlife experience suitable for kids aged 5+, priced at $85/adult, $45/child.
intro: The Cape Kidnappers Gannet Colony Tour is a unique wildlife experience that brings you up close to over 10,000 nesting gannets. As a family, we recently had the opportunity to take part in this tour and were blown away by the sheer number of birds and the stunning scenery. But is it suitable for families with young children?

sections.heading: What's it Like with Kids?
sections.body:
The tractor trek along the beach was a hit with our kids, who loved the bumpy ride and the excitement of possibly getting stuck in the sand. However, the 3-4 hour duration may be a challenge for younger children, and the minimum age requirement of 5+ is reasonable. The guided walk alternative is not suitable for young children due to its 6.5km length each way.

Despite the potential challenges, the tour is highly suitable for families, with a rating of 9/10. The kids were fascinated by the gannets and enjoyed learning about these amazing birds.

sections.heading: Value for Money and Insider Tips
sections.body:
The tour is priced at $85 per adult and $45 per child, which may seem steep for some families. However, the unique experience and the opportunity to see so many gannets up close make it well worth the cost. To save money, consider booking during the off-season or looking for package deals that include other activities.

One insider tip is to book the early morning tour to avoid the crowds and make the most of the cooler morning weather. Additionally, be sure to bring sunhats, sunscreen, and comfortable shoes, as you'll be spending several hours outdoors.

sections.heading: Best Time to Visit and How to Book
sections.body:
The best time to visit the Cape Kidnappers Gannet Colony is during the spring and summer months when the gannets are breeding and nesting. However, this is also the peak tourist season, so be prepared for larger crowds. To book the tour, simply visit the official website or contact the tour operator directly.

It's a good idea to book in advance, especially during peak season, to ensure availability. You can also ask about any special deals or discounts that may be available.

sections.heading: Downsides for Families
sections.body:
One potential downside of the tour is the early start time, which may be challenging for families with young children. Additionally, the tractor trek can be bumpy and may not be suitable for children with motion sickness. However, the tour operators are experienced and will do their best to accommodate your family's needs.

Overall, the Cape Kidnappers Gannet Colony Tour is a unique and unforgettable experience that is well worth the cost. With some planning and preparation, it can be a fun and educational experience for the whole family.
